blankMeaning: Unknown/unavailable, not zero. No fabricated leads or traffic source data.
windowRule: Keep source periods, timezones, filters and latest final dates explicit. Use separate completed7day operating view and matched28day trend periods.
primaryOutcome: Genuine deduplicated website-origin insurance inquiries with separately agency-qualified local subset. Private qualification/deduplication record; no personal identifiers in scorecard/GA4.
sourceCompatibility: GA4 and GSC rows are separate supplied snapshots, not one combined baseline. GSC click totals are not a sessions denominator.
rateRule: Verified submission session rate = sessions with one or more accepted website submissions / eligible measured sessions of the same source window/filter. Genuine inquiry rate unavailable without compatible attribution and denominator.
attribution: Confirmed/reported/unknown website origin tracked privately; unknown stays unknown. Session acquisition and first-user acquisition are not interchangeable.
measurementState: Phone clicks, connected calls, submissions, genuine inquiries and qualified leads are distinct; do not sum them. Tracking specification not implemented.
targetState: No numerical lead forecast or guarantee. Establish genuine baseline and agree a target first.
